g.text: Selected 6h HGB, pooled OOF 2022–2023. Each time block has 53,610 eligible cells; local time is Asia/Bangkok.
Source: analysis/slices_6h.csv, time_block dimension. Negative bias = underprediction; positive = overprediction.
Higher counts in a time block are not exposure-adjusted personal risk: the number of vehicles using the road is not known.
